title: Week 3 — Indicators of Sacred Law: The Sunnah
subtitle: Prophetic Sunnah · Authenticity · Mutawātir · Āḥād
description: Study the Prophetic Sunnah as a legal source: its categories, roles relative to the Qurʾān, conditions of authenticity, and classifications by number of narrators.
source: Islamic Legal Theory I course material.

questions.q: A report describes something the Prophet ﷺ said, did, or tacitly approved. Which source is being described?
Which set gives the three categories of Prophetic Sunnah in the material?
The Prophet ﷺ knew of an action performed by a Companion, did not disapprove of it, and remained silent. This is an example of:
The Sunnah explains the Qurʾān by detailing how to perform ḥajj. Which role is this?
options: Explaining an otherwise general or summarized command
Introducing a ruling unrelated to the Qurʾān

questions.q: The Sunnah limits the permissibility of bequeathing to heirs to one third of the estate in the example given. This is:
options: Providing a constraint to an unconstrained matter

questions.q: A report is narrated by one narrator in every stage of its chain. How is it classified by number of narrators in the material?
A report is narrated by two narrators in every stage of its chain. It is:
A report has a connected chain of upright, exact narrators, with no anomaly or hidden defect. It is classified as:
Which authenticity category describes a connected chain of upright narrators whose exactness is lower than that of ṣaḥīḥ narrators, without anomalies or hidden defects?
A narrator must have heard the report from the immediate narrator before him, with no missing links. Which condition is this?
A trustworthy narrator’s version must not conflict with the version of a more trustworthy narrator. Which condition does this describe?
options: Absence of hidden defects (al-khuluww min al-ʿillah)

questions.q: According to the material, probability in the meaning/indication of a Sunnah text does not by itself remove the Sunnah’s status as a valid indicator.
Which statement best reflects the material’s position on āḥād Sunnah?
options: It is never a valid indicator
It is valid as an indicator when the report meets the conditions of authenticity
It is valid only when it is mutawātir
It is always qaṭʿī in transmission

questions.q: Name the three categories of āḥād Sunnah according to number of narrators.
Name the five conditions of authenticity for āḥād Sunnah reports listed in the material.
acceptedAnswers: connectedness of chain, uprightness of narrators, exactness of narrators, absence of anomalies, absence of hidden defects
ittisal al sanad, adalat al ruwah, dabt al ruwah, absence of shudhudh, absence of illa
questions.displayAnswer: Connectedness of the chain; uprightness of narrators; exactness of narrators; absence of anomalies; and absence of hidden defects.

questions.q: How does the material define “mutawātir Sunnah”?
options: Reports narrated in the first three eras by multiple narrators in each stage whose collaboration to fabricate a lie is normally impossible
Reports narrated by a single narrator in every stage of the chain
Reports narrated by narrators with a lower level of exactness
Reports whose chain has a missing link

questions.q: Which example does the material give of a Sunnah transmitted by tawātur?
options: The report recommending ghusl on Fridays
How the Prophet ﷺ performed prayers
The report that a murderer does not inherit

questions.q: “Āḥād Sunnah” refers to reports that are:
options: Narrated by a large number of narrators at every stage
Narrated by a small number of narrators in any stage of the chain, or by multiple narrators whose number does not reach the level of mutawātir
Only those narrated by the Companions
Only those with a weak chain

questions.q: The Prophet’s statement that a murderer does not inherit from the one he murdered (Sunan Ibn Mājah) is given as an example of a Sunnah that is:
“Mashhūr” reports are those narrated by:
options: Three or more narrators in every stage, as long as their number does not reach the level of mutawātir
A large number of narrators such that lying is impossible

questions.q: According to the material, if a Sunnah is not narrated by tawātur, it is still a valid source as long as the report meets the conditions of authenticity.
Which example does the material give of a Prophetic action that is not Sunnah intended for all Muslims?
options: Marrying more than four wives, which is permissible for the Prophet ﷺ only

questions.q: Most jurists, unlike Ḥanafī jurists, consider āḥād Prophetic Sunnah a valid indicator in penal law, such as acting on an āḥād report about a fixed punishment alongside the Qurʾānic verse.

In the tacit-approval example, a Companion who had a wet dream used dry ablution (tayammum) due to the cold, then led others in prayer. The Prophet ﷺ laughed and said nothing. What does this tacit approval indicate?
Both the Qurʾān and the Sunnah oblige the fast of Ramadan. Which role of the Sunnah vis-à-vis the Qurʾān does this illustrate?
options: Introducing a new ruling not mentioned in the Qurʾān

questions.q: The Qurʾān forbids consuming dead animals, but the Sunnah excludes sea animals from this prohibition. This is an example of the Sunnah:
options: Giving specific details of how a command is carried out
Providing limitations to a general rule with a wide scope

questions.q: The Sunnah makes it impermissible for a man to marry a woman and her aunt at the same time. Which role does this illustrate?
options: Explaining the Qurʾān by giving details
Introducing a new ruling that the Qurʾān is silent about
Providing constraints to an unconstrained matter

questions.q: A “mursal al-ṣaḥābī” report is one in which:
options: A Companion attributes a report to the Prophet ﷺ although he did not hear it directly from him, having heard it from another narrator whom he does not name
A non-Companion narrates a report with a missing link
A trustworthy narrator adds a phrase not found in other versions
A report is narrated by only one narrator in every stage

questions.q: “Ziyādat al-thiqa” refers to a report in which:
options: A weak narrator contradicts a stronger narrator
One trustworthy narrator narrates, in his version, an addition that is not found in other versions of the same report
The chain of narrators is disconnected
The report is narrated by tawātur

questions.q: According to the material, “mursal ghayr al-ṣaḥābī” and “mursal” are synonyms.
